title: Raccoon Island Private Boat Charter Experience from Miami
includes: Independent USCG-licensed captains available for selection.
BYOB: Bring your own drinks and snacks onboard.
Premium Sound System: Play your own Music
Captain & Fuel Surcharges (Agreement with Government for all Miami Private Boats) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Maximum amount of Passengers is 10, including Toddlers and Kids.
At least one traveler must be 18 years or older.
policies: Customer must leave their shoes on a basket prior to boarding.
Sunscreen must be applied prior to getting on the water, to prevent stains in the cushions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This isn’t your average crowded group tour — this is your boat, your day, your way.

Enjoy a completely private charter with just your group aboard a sleek, spacious vessel equipped with a premium sound system, comfortable lounge seating, and plenty of shade. You’ll cruise through Biscayne Bay to three of Miami’s best-kept secrets: Indian Creek, known as Billionaire's Bunker, the wildlife-rich Raccoon Island and the famous Haulover Sandbar, known for its clear shallow waters and fun social vibe.

Bring your own drinks and snacks — there’s a cooler onboard with ice and bottled water waiting for you. Whether you want to swim, unwind, party, or spot wildlife, this private charter gives you the freedom to create the perfect day on the water. No crowds. No rush. Just you, the captain you choose, and the best of Miami by boat.
